scientific_integrity: Direct finite path enumerations and exact rational generating-series checks supplement, but do not replace, a full analytic proof; closest prior literature and its implied aggregate information are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: The fixed-dimensional fast-reset expansion has implicit constants depending on the lattice dimension and starting site.
The separate growing-dimension expansion assumes the axial distance-two start and reset rate proportional to dimension with positive coefficient.
The model has homogeneous nearest-neighbor continuous-time lattice hops and independent Poisson resetting to a fixed site.
An unmarked aggregate correction is implicit in existing lattice Green functions; the claimed contribution is marked geometry and the successful-segment duration correction.
The literature comparison and mathematical review are not independent validation.
title: Directional first-detour law and sharp successful-excursion localization under lattice resetting
